Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent (codewithbullet.com)
94 points by adi1 16 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 71 comments

Hi HN! We’re Adi and Alex, founders of Bullet, a faster coding agent.

Bullet started in a senior year dorm. We were fresh out of working at AppLovin and Citadel, and naturally thought we were on a sure path to startup success. We were going to use our skills optimizing stock pricing calculation speeds and agent document context to take over the world. So, Bullet started as an AI hedge fund, a browser-use agent, synthetic financial data (oof), a mobile IDE, and a bunch of other things. We wanted to build something people wanted, but it seemed like everything we built was just terrible, useless, or both.

So, we decided to do something completely different, something completely out of the blue, something that no one had ever done before. Solve a problem we actually had.

Over the course of six pivots, we suffered. Throughout all of our adventures, one final boss kept getting in our way. Claude Code and his little brother Codex. We were spending hours waiting for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, and got so frustrated to the point that I downloaded the Claude Code whip. We had spent months of time waiting for six codebases-worth of useless coding agent work.

Lightbulb moment. There’s nothing more noble than destroying the institutions! Let’s take on Claude Code and Codex, we can do it! Piece of cake!

And so, Bullet started off as a side project. We used the Claude Code to improve the Claude Code:

1. Model routing. Do you regret giving a task to Fable when it could have literally been done by Sonnet?

2. Targeted code + context search. We think embedding the whole repo is dumb. We also think sticking the whole context (or compressed context) in chat is dumb. So we do faster and better greps over both.

3. Aggressive context hygiene. Tool output is bounded, stale screenshots disappear, we don’t re-read files…the garbage never floods the model.

4. Efficient turns. Batch independent investigation, make one surgical edit, then perform one focused verification. Internal measurement showed 16% fewer round trips and 27% lower cost.

5. The Flash. We prayed to Barry Allen for speed.

And thank the Flash, he gave us speed! On SWE-bench Verified, Bullet resolved 479/500 (95.8%) in one attempt, averaging 119s per task, 35–67% faster than mini-SWE-agent + Fable/Sol depending on task. Full results and methodology here (https://www.codewithbullet.com/blog/benchmark-results.html)

Eventually we started using it every day and never went back.

Listed above were just some of the things about Claude Code that frustrated us the most, but we are constantly optimizing every day (look at that, maybe we did learn something from our jobs).

In our development, the biggest insight was that model speed matters less than reducing round trips. Independent searches, reads, and commands should happen in parallel, while dependent editing and verification stay sequential. One surprising obstacle was code search, small issues like regex-dialect mismatches caused silent misses and sent agents down completely wrong paths, so we built targeted search with fallbacks and bounded context. The most interesting use case so far has been long iterative work (like benchmarks, data pipelines, and evaluation loops), where each step depends on the last and running multiple agents can’t help as much.

Here’s the video demo (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWVmG5fRKgE)

We hope that you guys try out Bullet if you are suffering with speed as much as we were, and we hope it brings you joy, rainbows, and faster responses. And if it’s terrible, let us know it’s terrible (we’re masochists btw)! We'll be in the comments all day, you can also contact us at bullet@davidhf.com.

You can try it at https://codewithbullet.com.

P.S: we hid a code on the website, see if you can unlock the secret page at the footer, all built with Bullet

sentences.zh: 没有什么比摧毁机构更高尚的了！

sentences.en: Let’s take on Claude Code and Codex, we can do it!
sentences.zh: 让我们挑战 Claude Code 和 Codex，我们能做到！

sentences.en: Piece of cake!And so, Bullet started off as a side project.
sentences.zh: 小菜一碟！因此，Bullet 最初是作为一个业余项目开始的。

sentences.en: We used the Claude Code to improve the Claude Code:1.
sentences.zh: 我们利用克劳德码来改进克劳德码： 1．

sentences.en: Model routing.
sentences.zh: 模型路由。

sentences.en: Do you regret giving a task to Fable when it could have literally been done by Sonnet?2.
sentences.zh: 您是否后悔将一项本来可以由 Sonnet 完成的任务交给《寓言》？2。

sentences.en: Targeted code + context search.
sentences.zh: 目标代码+上下文搜索。

sentences.en: We think embedding the whole repo is dumb.
sentences.zh: 我们认为嵌入整个存储库是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: We also think sticking the whole context (or compressed context) in chat is dumb.
sentences.zh: 我们还认为将整个上下文（或压缩上下文）保留在聊天中是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: So we do faster and better greps over both.3.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对两者进行更快更好的 grep 操作。3。

sentences.en: Aggressive context hygiene.
sentences.zh: 积极的环境卫生。

sentences.en: Tool output is bounded, stale screenshots disappear, we don’t re-read files…the garbage never floods the model.4.
sentences.zh: 工具输出是有限的，陈旧的屏幕截图会消失，我们不会重新读取文件......垃圾永远不会淹没模型。4。

sentences.en: Efficient turns.
sentences.zh: 高效转弯。

sentences.en: Batch independent investigation, make one surgical edit, then perform one focused verification.
sentences.zh: 批量独立调查，进行一项外科手术编辑，然后执行一项重点验证。

sentences.en: Internal measurement showed 16% fewer round trips and 27% lower cost.5.
sentences.zh: 内部测量显示往返次数减少了 16%，成本降低了 27%。5。

sentences.en: The Flash.
sentences.zh: 闪电侠。

sentences.en: We prayed to Barry Allen for speed.And thank the Flash, he gave us speed!
sentences.zh: 我们向巴里艾伦祈祷速度。感谢闪电侠，他给了我们速度！

sentences.en: On SWE-bench Verified, Bullet resolved 479/500 (95.8%) in one attempt, averaging 119s per task, 35–67% faster than mini-SWE-agent + Fable/Sol depending on task.
sentences.zh: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，Bullet 一次尝试解决了 479/500 (95.8%)，平均每个任务 119 秒，比 mini-SWE-agent + Fable/Sol 快 35–67%，具体取决于任务。

sentences.en: Full results and methodology here (https://www.codewithbullet.com/blog/benchmark-results.html)Eventually we started using it every day and never went back.Listed above were just some of the things about Claude Code that frustrated us the most, but we are constantly optimizing every day (look at that, maybe we did learn something from our jobs).In our development, the biggest insight was that model speed matters less than reducing round trips.
sentences.zh: 完整的结果和方法在这里（https://www.codewithbullet.com/blog/benchmark-results.html）最终我们开始每天使用它，再也没有回去过。上面列出的只是 Claude Code 中最让我们沮丧的一些事情，但我们每天都在不断优化（看看那个，也许我们确实从我们的工作中学到了一些东西）。在我们的开发中，最大的见解是模型速度比减少往返更重要。

sentences.en: Independent searches, reads, and commands should happen in parallel, while dependent editing and verification stay sequential.
sentences.zh: 独立的搜索、读取和命令应该并行发生，而相关的编辑和验证保持顺序。

sentences.en: One surprising obstacle was code search, small issues like regex-dialect mismatches caused silent misses and sent agents down completely wrong paths, so we built targeted search with fallbacks and bounded context.
sentences.zh: 一个令人惊讶的障碍是代码搜索，诸如正则表达式方言不匹配之类的小问题会导致无声的失误，并使代理走上完全错误的道路，因此我们构建了具有回退和有界上下文的有针对性的搜索。

sentences.en: The most interesting use case so far has been long iterative work (like benchmarks, data pipelines, and evaluation loops), where each step depends on the last and running multiple agents can’t help as much.Here’s the video demo (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWVmG5fRKgE)We hope that you guys try out Bullet if you are suffering with speed as much as we were, and we hope it brings you joy, rainbows, and faster responses.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，最有趣的用例是长时间的迭代工作（例如基准测试、数据管道和评估循环），其中每一步都取决于最后一步，运行多个代理并没有多大帮助。这是视频演示（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWVmG5fRKgE）如果您像我们一样遭受速度困扰，我们希望你们尝试一下 Bullet，我们希望它能给您带来快乐、彩虹和更快的响应。

sentences.en: And if it’s terrible, let us know it’s terrible (we’re masochists btw)!
sentences.zh: 如果这很糟糕，请让我们知道这很糟糕（顺便说一句，我们是受虐狂）！

sentences.en: We'll be in the comments all day, you can also contact us at bullet@davidhf.com.You can try it at https://codewithbullet.com.P.S: we hid a code on the website, see if you can unlock the secret page at the footer, all built with Bullet
sentences.zh: 我们会全天在评论里，您也可以通过bullet@davidhf.com联系我们。您可以在https://codewithbullet.com尝试一下。P.S：我们在网站上隐藏了一个代码，看看您是否可以解锁页脚的秘密页面，全部由Bullet构建

content_html_zh: 启动 HN: Bullet (YC S26) – 更快的编码代理 (codewithbullet.com)94 分 by adi1 16 小时前 |隐藏 |过去|最喜欢 | 71 条评论嗨 HN！ 我们是 Adi 和 Alex，是 Bullet（更快的编码代理）的创始人。Bullet 始于高年级宿舍。 我们刚刚结束在 AppLovin 和 Citadel 的工作，很自然地认为我们已经走上了创业成功的必经之路。 我们将利用我们的技能优化股票定价计算速度和代理文档上下文来接管世界。 因此，Bullet 最初是一家人工智能对冲基金、浏览器使用代理、合成金融数据 (oof)、移动 IDE 以及其他一些东西。 我们想要建造一些人们想要的东西，但看起来我们建造的所有东西都很糟糕，毫无用处，或者两者兼而有之。所以，我们决定做一些完全不同的事情，一些完全出乎意料的事情，一些以前没有人做过的事情。 解决我们实际遇到的问题。在六个支点的过程中，我们遭受了痛苦。 在我们所有的冒险过程中，最终的 Boss 一直在阻碍我们。 克劳德·科德和他的弟弟科德克斯。 我们花了几个小时等待像 Claude Code 和 Codex 这样的编码代理，并且非常沮丧，以至于我下载了 Claude Code 鞭子。 我们花了几个月的时间等待六个代码库的无用编码代理工作。灯泡时刻。 没有什么比摧毁机构更高尚的了！ 让我们挑战 Claude Code 和 Codex，我们能做到！ 小菜一碟！因此，Bullet 最初是作为一个业余项目开始的。 我们利用克劳德码来改进克劳德码： 1． 模型路由。 您是否后悔将一项本来可以由 Sonnet 完成的任务交给《寓言》？2。 目标代码+上下文搜索。 我们认为嵌入整个存储库是愚蠢的。 我们还认为将整个上下文（或压缩上下文）保留在聊天中是愚蠢的。 所以我们对两者进行更快更好的 grep 操作。3。 积极的环境卫生。 工具输出是有限的，陈旧的屏幕截图会消失，我们不会重新读取文件......垃圾永远不会淹没模型。4。 高效转弯。 批量独立调查，进行一项外科手术编辑，然后执行一项重点验证。 内部测量显示往返次数减少了 16%，成本降低了 27%。5。 闪电侠。 我们向巴里艾伦祈祷速度。感谢闪电侠，他给了我们速度！ 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，Bullet 一次尝试解决了 479/500 (95.8%)，平均每个任务 119 秒，比 mini-SWE-agent + Fable/Sol 快 35–67%，具体取决于任务。 完整的结果和方法在这里（https://www.codewithbullet.com/blog/benchmark-results.html）最终我们开始每天使用它，再也没有回去过。上面列出的只是 Claude Code 中最让我们沮丧的一些事情，但我们每天都在不断优化（看看那个，也许我们确实从我们的工作中学到了一些东西）。在我们的开发中，最大的见解是模型速度比减少往返更重要。 独立的搜索、读取和命令应该并行发生，而相关的编辑和验证保持顺序。 一个令人惊讶的障碍是代码搜索，诸如正则表达式方言不匹配之类的小问题会导致无声的失误，并使代理走上完全错误的道路，因此我们构建了具有回退和有界上下文的有针对性的搜索。 到目前为止，最有趣的用例是长时间的迭代工作（例如基准测试、数据管道和评估循环），其中每一步都取决于最后一步，运行多个代理并没有多大帮助。这是视频演示（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWVmG5fRKgE）如果您像我们一样遭受速度困扰，我们希望你们尝试一下 Bullet，我们希望它能给您带来快乐、彩虹和更快的响应。 如果这很糟糕，请让我们知道这很糟糕（顺便说一句，我们是受虐狂）！ 我们会全天在评论里，您也可以通过bullet@davidhf.com联系我们。您可以在https://codewithbullet.com尝试一下。P.S：我们在网站上隐藏了一个代码，看看您是否可以解锁页脚的秘密页面，全部由Bullet帮助构建
